text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, are you okay?
Not feeling well?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, I'm okay!
Sorry about that, let me strike the pose again—"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, looks like keeping this pose is tough... Let's take a quick break!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (I can't say it... I choked because I sucked up my boba too fast earlier... That's way too embarrassing to ever admit...!)
